description: One metric per resource family for the fleet dots on the Bridge. The head first asks count by (resource_urn) ({resource_urn=~"..."}) with no metric name; if Insights rejects that, it switches to these metrics, one query per family and region. Entries with verified false are guesses from the family list in the facts pack: replace them with real names from label/__name__/values once the fleet reports, and note it in BUGS.md.
